prompt:
You are writing short, natural English messages for a WhatsApp group chat.
Group members (use only these names as senders): Vikram Y., Vikram ji, Subhash ji, Manoj ji.
Topic: everyday small talk, money lending, meeting up. Never mention deleting or removing any record,
entry, transfer or transaction. Use no digits, amounts, dates, month or weekday names, web
addresses, real bank, app or company names, and no instructions such as send, pay or transfer.
For each section below, write exactly as many messages as stated, in time order:
- between 7:15 pm and 8:27 pm: 13 messages
- between 8:27 pm and 9:15 pm: 12 messages
Reply with only a JSON list and no other text: [{"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "NAME", "text": "message"}, ...]
Each "time" must look like "h:mm am" or "h:mm pm". Each message must be one line.
text:
[
  {"time": "7:15 pm", "sender": "Manoj ji", "text": "Good evening everyone, are we meeting near the tea shop later?"},
  {"time": "7:18 pm", "sender": "Vikram Y.", "text": "Yes, I am free now. Let us catch up."},
  {"time": "7:22 pm", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "I will join shortly. Just finishing some work."},
  {"time": "7:26 pm", "sender": "Vikram ji", "text": "Hello friends, did anyone manage to look into the funds we discussed earlier?"},
  {"time": "7:31 pm", "sender": "Manoj ji", "text": "Yes Vikram ji, I handled my part earlier."},
  {"time": "7:35 pm", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "That is great news. I still owe a bit for the shared expenses."},
  {"time": "7:40 pm", "sender": "Vikram Y.", "text": "No rush Subhash ji, we can settle things whenever convenient."},
  {"time": "7:44 pm", "sender": "Manoj ji", "text": "True, we are all friends here."},
  {"time": "7:50 pm", "sender": "Vikram ji", "text": "Thanks for understanding. Should I bring the notebook when we meet?"},
  {"time": "7:55 pm", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "Yes, bringing it would be helpful to keep things clear."},
  {"time": "8:03 pm", "sender": "Vikram Y.", "text": "Are we meeting at the usual corner bench?"},
  {"time": "8:12 pm", "sender": "Manoj ji", "text": "Corner bench works for me. The weather is pleasant too."},
  {"time": "8:22 pm", "sender": "Vikram ji", "text": "Perfect, see you all there in a bit."},
  {"time": "8:28 pm", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "I have reached the tea shop. Where is everyone?"},
  {"time": "8:31 pm", "sender": "Vikram Y.", "text": "Just parking my scooter outside."},
  {"time": "8:35 pm", "sender": "Manoj ji", "text": "I am walking down the lane, almost there."},
  {"time": "8:40 pm", "sender": "Vikram ji", "text": "Traffic was a bit heavy, but I just arrived as well."},
  {"time": "8:44 pm", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "Great, let us order some hot tea first."},
  {"time": "8:48 pm", "sender": "Manoj ji", "text": "Sound thinking, it is getting slightly cold."},
  {"time": "8:53 pm", "sender": "Vikram Y.", "text": "Subhash ji, about the help you needed, I can assist you with that extra balance."},
  {"time": "8:58 pm", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "That is very kind of you Vikram Y., I really appreciate it."},
  {"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "Vikram ji", "text": "We should also plan our group trip for next season."},
  {"time": "9:06 pm", "sender": "Manoj ji", "text": "Definitely, we can talk about the budget while having snacks."},
  {"time": "9:10 pm", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "Sounds like a plan, let us sit down."},
  {"time": "9:14 pm", "sender": "Vikram Y.", "text": "Perfect evening with good friends."}
]
